title: Veterans Pension — Share of a Retroactive Compensation Release Counted as Income by the Months It Covers
content:
# Months covered by a retroactive Disability Compensation release — Veterans Pension income

**Clause.** In the veteran's benefit income statement on his Veterans Pension award, the share of the retroactive Disability Compensation releases that counts is set by the months they cover, judged from the effective date of the Disability Compensation award, the payment date of the most recent retroactive release in its payment ledger, and the effective date of the pension award:

1. When the compensation effective date falls before the pension effective date and the release was issued after the pension effective date, only the share equal to the months before pension was first paid divided by the whole months from the compensation effective date to the release date counts. The months before pension was first paid are the whole months from the compensation effective date to the pension effective date plus the months by which pension payment starts after its effective date (the product's payment start lag of 1 month).
2. When the compensation effective date falls on or after the pension effective date, none of it counts, because every month it covers is a month of pension.
3. In every other case all of it counts — a share of 1.

The share is applied to the releases less any representative's fee taken out of them, and the result is rounded to the cent.

## Judgement grid

| Compensation effective date vs pension effective date | Release issued after the pension effective date | Share counted |
|---|---|---|
| before | yes | months before pension was first paid, divided by whole months from compensation effective date to release date |
| before | no | 1 (all) |
| on or after | — | 0 (none) |

## Worked example (hypothetical dates)

Compensation effective 2024-01-01; pension effective 2024-07-01; release issued 2025-01-01. Whole months from compensation effective date to pension effective date: 6; plus the 1-month payment start lag: 7 months before pension was first paid. Whole months from compensation effective date to release date: 12. Share: 7 divided by 12. A release of 12000.00 with no fee taken out counts 7000.00.
